sources.title: Yardsort recovery-workflow
sources.locator: Named pinned code and associated guide read independently 2026-11-25
sources.finding: Built-in Software factory collects brief/questions/acceptance criteria, context/plan files, explicit plan approval, implementation, gated smoke test, separate reviewer and human accept-review/release decisions. needs dependencies and bounded attempts; three attempts in built-in loops, parser allows2–10. Agent instructions do not enforce prose correctness or independent reviewer identity. Release approval ends/report/notifies without merge/deploy. engine.rs/driver.rs store gate verdict, attempts and artifacts; waits resume, interrupted effects fail rather than execute twice.

sources.finding: Named artifacts from file/text/output/brief/transcript;32kcharacter cap,1MiB file read cap and path validation. sources.title: Yardsort recovery-smoke
sources.locator: Named pinned code and associated guide read independently 2026-11-25
sources.finding: Runs get own port/scratch directory; setup/steps/always teardown, five-minute default step/thirty-minute run,16MiB output cap, process-tree kill on stop. Changed YAML hash needs approval; CLI cannot approve. Cancel stops test descendants, restart marks interrupted run errored and kills identified orphan servers. Default output retention30days configurable by project. Unlike smoke cancel, workflow cancel leaves started agent sessions running.

sources.title: Yardsort recovery-setup
sources.locator: Named pinned code and associated guide read independently 2026-11-25
sources.finding: Per-project settings copy listed relative regular files without overwrite/symlink/traversal, run setup before agent in new/restored owned worktrees;600sec process-tree timeout and0600 private git-dir log. Failed setup keeps worktree, blocks agent; manual repair. Imports/local do not run setup. Run button reuses workspace server, ports user-configured outside smoke tests.

sources.title: Yardsort recovery-remote
sources.locator: Named pinned code and associated guide read independently 2026-11-25
sources.finding: Optional public desktop-to-desktop/host path; phone invite-only and not available as shipped phone yes. Same account pairing with project scope and view/type/workflow permission. Any devices watch but one types, host typing takes back. Revocable grants. Server sees plaintext in transit after TLS termination, synchronized approved memory stored server-side. Host dashboard is setup shell only, no workspace/agent conversations; loopback one-time10min login,30daybrowser session. OIDC identity is not established enterprise SSO.

sources.title: Yardsort recovery-host

Host dashboard setup runs shell with host user. Source server self-host recipe uses ZITADEL OIDC and per-account device revocation. Public host/desktop beta differs from invite-only phone.

sources.title: Yardsort recovery-permissions
